summary: project_knowledge_gates is a pure projection function; inputs: catalog_stale, read_set_same, source_bytes_same booleans; stale catalog + unchanged read set + unchanged source bytes -> route degraded-continuation, publication disallowed, review not required; unchanged read set + changed source bytes -> route successor-refresh, publication disallowed, review not required; all other states -> route repair-required, publication disallowed, review required; no ambiguous behavior
